title: Mass-splitting degeneracy: why a single recoil cannot fix m_chi above 400 GeV, what the onset and endpoint do, and the (m, delta) ridge
question: Which combination of (m_chi, delta) does an inelastic-O1 xenon recoil spectrum fix, how well could an extended-window xenon detector break the residual mass degeneracy with the onset, endpoint, annual modulation or a fixed-coupling rate, and what does this mean for the Higgsino at 300 GeV / 1.1 TeV / 4 TeV?
headline_result: The (m, delta) degeneracy is a ridge nearly flat in delta (KL-minimising delta_b = 298.6/300/299.7/299.2/298.7 keV at 0.7/1/2/4/10 TeV for a 300 keV reference; 355.8/366/375.6/380.3/383.0 keV for 366 keV), not delta*mu/m_N = const (wrong sign); 3-sigma separation of 1 from 4 TeV needs 642 events by shape or 243 by modulation, the endpoint is unobservable (<=0.9% above 500 keV), and the fixed-coupling Higgsino delta(N=1) curve runs within 4 keV of the ridge so the rate adds no mass information
key_numbers: Fisher per event (1000 GeV, 366 keV, 5-1000 keV, annual): sigma_delta 20.9 (m fixed)/36.3 keV (m free), sigma_lnm 2.06, corr -0.82, ridge +14.5 keV per ln m; LZ-like window sigma_delta(m free) 255 keV; N_3sigma 1 vs 4 TeV 642 shape/1544 LZ-like/243 timing/~180 combined; 400 GeV vs 4 TeV 11 (ref 366), 245 (ref 300), 130 (same delta 300); KS(400 vs 4000, delta 300) 0.13; a1 1.20/0.90/0.79/0.74 and June/Dec 28/7.9/5.6/4.8 at 1/2/4/10 TeV (366 ridge); E+ 501/738 keV (1/4 TeV), 0.02/0.93% above 500 keV; Higgsino delta(N=1) 312/343/366/368/375/377/374 keV (0.3-10 TeV), N_LZ along ridge 1.01/1.36/1.04/0.52; 300 GeV Higgsino separable with 8 events
model_or_mechanism: inelastic O1 isoscalar (WimPyDD, exact per-isotope kernel factorisation, 1/m scaling); KL maps and ridge in (m, delta); Fisher information in (ln m, delta) with fixed-coupling rate term; exact two-hypothesis N_3sigma; 24-day modulation; Higgsino/multiplet delta(N=1) anchored to P007
confidence: medium: exact factorised WimPyDD spectra and normalisations validated against P007/P037/P050/P034, but O1-only, ideal extended window, local Fisher, one halo family
